scenes.description: Sparkling Christmas Tree with Gifts and Twinkling Lights
Chinese Lunar New Year with Red Lanterns and Envelopes
Spooky Fun Halloween with Jack-o'-Lantern Pumpkins and Costumes

character_line.en: Look at the glowing green tree with ornaments! What festival is this?
character_line.zh: 看掛滿裝飾品閃閃發光的綠樹！這是什麼節日呢？

options.en: It is Christmas! Merry Christmas, Benny!

options.hint: 滿是彩燈禮物的常青樹是聖誕節「Christmas」喔！
祝小熊 Benny「Merry Christmas」聖誕快樂吧！

character_line.en: Merry Christmas! What surprise is waiting under the tree?
character_line.zh: 聖誕快樂！聖誕樹下等著什麼驚喜呢？

options.en: There are colorful gift boxes for everyone!
options.zh: 有給每個人的彩色禮物盒！

options.hint: 聖誕樹下擺滿了精美的禮物盒「gift boxes」喔！
告訴 Benny 樹下有大家期待的驚喜禮物盒喔！

character_line.en: Now the whole town is decorated with bright red lanterns! What holiday is coming?
character_line.zh: 現在整個城鎮都掛滿亮紅色燈籠！什麼節日要到了呢？

options.en: It is Lunar New Year! We get red envelopes!
options.zh: 是農曆新年！我們會拿到紅包！

options.hint: 掛紅燈籠拿紅包的是農曆新年「Lunar New Year」喔！
告訴 Benny 紅通通的節日是熱鬧的農曆新年喔！

character_line.en: Red envelopes and dumplings! Who do we visit during Lunar New Year?
character_line.zh: 紅包和好吃的餃子！農曆新年期間我們會拜訪誰呢？

options.en: We visit our grandparents and family!
options.zh: 我們會拜訪阿公阿嬤和親戚家人！

options.hint: 過年時我們會拜訪阿公阿嬤與親戚家人「grandparents and family」喔！
告訴 Benny 全家人聚在一起吃年夜飯的習俗喔！

character_line.en: Look at the glowing orange pumpkin lantern! What spooky holiday is tonight?
character_line.zh: 看那發光的橘色南瓜燈！今晚是什麼搞怪又好玩的節日呢？

options.en: It is Halloween! Trick or treat!
options.zh: 是萬聖節！不給糖就搗蛋！

options.hint: 刻著南瓜燈扮裝要糖果的是萬聖節「Halloween」喔！
說出最經典的萬聖節密語「Trick or treat」喔！

character_line.en: Haha, your cute costume is wonderful! Holidays bring so much joy, right?
character_line.zh: 哈哈，你的可愛裝扮太棒了！節慶帶來好多歡樂對不對？

options.en: Yes! Every holiday is magical and fun!
options.zh: 是的！每個節日都充滿魔法與歡樂！

options.hint: 贊同每一個節日都充滿魔力與歡樂「magical and fun」喔！
跟 Benny 一起慶祝每個美好的節日吧！
